name: shield-comment-e2e
description: Playwright gate suite for ShieldComment BD, run against the docker compose stack

scripts.test:docker: cd .. && E2E_RUN_ID=${E2E_RUN_ID:-$(date +%s)} E2E_GRAPH_STUB_URL=http://e2e:4010 docker compose --profile e2e run --rm --build --use-aliases e2e; s=$?; docker compose --profile e2e rm -sf backend-e2e; exit $s
